[
  {
    "n": 1,
    "kind": "Example",
    "title": "First-Order Separable Equation Yielding Concentric Circles",
    "source": "Chapter 1",
    "statement": "Solve the separable differential equation dy/dx = -x/y and find the family of solution curves."
  },
  {
    "n": 2,
    "kind": "Example",
    "title": "Initial Value Problem with Partial Fractions and Singular Solutions",
    "source": "Chapter 1",
    "statement": "Solve the initial value problem xy' + y = y^2 with initial condition y(1) = 0.5, identifying any lost solutions."
  },
  {
    "n": 3,
    "kind": "Example",
    "title": "Malthusian Population Dynamics Model",
    "source": "Chapter 1",
    "statement": "Solve the initial value problem for exponential population growth dN/dt = (alpha - beta)N with N(0) = N_0."
  },
  {
    "n": 4,
    "kind": "Example",
    "title": "Verhulst Logistic Population Dynamics Model",
    "source": "Chapter 1",
    "statement": "Solve the constrained population growth differential equation dN/dt = alpha(1 - N/N_p)N subject to N(0) = N_0, where N_p is the equilibrium population capacity."
  },
  {
    "n": 5,
    "kind": "Example",
    "title": "Reduction via Linear Argument Substitution",
    "source": "Chapter 1",
    "statement": "Solve the differential equation dy/dx = 1/(x - y) + 1 using the substitution z = x - y."
  },
  {
    "n": 6,
    "kind": "Example",
    "title": "Homogeneous Differential Equation with Trigonometric Term",
    "source": "Chapter 1",
    "statement": "Solve the first-order homogeneous differential equation dy/dx = y/x + tan(y/x) using the substitution z = y/x."
  }
]
